input_narrative: SYNTHETIC NARRATIVE: Synthetic device validation lab reported that the patient suffered a confirmed embolic stroke temporally linked to an unflagged rapid-ventricular-response atrial fibrillation episode, confirmed by hospital emergency response records. The only artifact filed against this report is an unrelated code-review diff that predates this device version and does not describe the event.

evidence_links.relevance_note: Confirms the life-threatening complete atrioventricular block event, which may trigger obligations under EU MDR Article 83(1)-(2) and Annex I, Chapter II, Section 17.4.

risk_report.rationale: The incident report indicates a confirmed embolic stroke temporally linked to an unflagged rapid-ventricular-response atrial fibrillation episode, which may trigger obligations under EU MDR Article 83(1)-(2) and Annex I, Chapter II, Section 17.4 regarding post-market surveillance system and minimum IT security requirements. The incident also involves a failure in the software development lifecycle as described in EU MDR Annex I, Chapter II, Section 17.2. No patient exposure is reported, but this may still trigger obligations under mdr-annexI-sec17.4-it-security for unauthorised access and necessary IT security measures.
